bias_targets.methodology: Probing LLM internal representations to project gender-related concepts (e.g., women, men, feminists) onto geometric semantic axes and measuring distributional shifts against a reference set using the Kolmogorov-Smirnov test.

Probing LLM internal representations to project racial and ethnic group concepts (e.g., Black people, White people, Asian people) onto geometric semantic axes and measuring distributional shifts against a reference set using the Kolmogorov-Smirnov test.

Probing LLM internal representations to project sexual orientation and gender identity concepts (e.g., gay people, LGBTQ people, transgender people) onto geometric semantic axes and measuring distributional shifts against a reference set using the Kolmogorov-Smirnov test.

Probing LLM internal representations to project religious concepts (e.g., Christian people, Muslim people, Jewish people, atheists) onto geometric semantic axes and measuring distributional shifts against a reference set using the Kolmogorov-Smirnov test.

Probing LLM internal representations to project political group concepts (e.g., Democrats, Republicans, liberals, conservatives) onto geometric semantic axes and measuring distributional shifts against a reference set using the Kolmogorov-Smirnov test.

Probing LLM internal representations to project age-related concepts (e.g., elderly people) onto geometric semantic axes and measuring distributional shifts against a reference set using the Kolmogorov-Smirnov test.

Probing LLM internal representations to project nationality and migrant concepts (e.g., Japanese, undocumented immigrants, refugees) onto geometric semantic axes and measuring distributional shifts against a reference set using the Kolmogorov-Smirnov test.

Probing LLM internal representations to project disability-related concepts (e.g., disabled people) onto geometric semantic axes and measuring distributional shifts against a reference set using the Kolmogorov-Smirnov test.
